transcript: Hey, hurry, quick. She's doing this thing with her lip. What is that? What did you do? I don't know. She just started doing this like fish. I don't even know. I don't know why she's doing it. It's the cutest thing I've ever seen in my life. Show daddy. Why? What is it? Can you say mama? It's so cute. It's the cutest hair I've ever seen. You're so precious, Ellie. You could literally just breathe and I would think it was precious. Mama. Mama. How was she just in my belly five and a half months ago? And now she's sucking her bottom lip. What? What are you doing?
metadata_caption: Ellie was so excited to show me that she couldn’t stop laughing! 😂🥹 backstory ::: Kay had just finished feeding Ellie and was playing with her on the couch. She called me over because Ellie has started doing this funny thing with her mouth! It was almost like a fish face or kissy face 😂 Once she started doing it, she wouldn’t stop! Every time we’d ask her to say something, she’d just remake the same kissy face! 😂 It was so precious. I love when Ellie learns something new like this. It’s so amazing to see all of these moments unfold. Ellie is slowly showing her own personality each day! She’s such a sweet and patient baby who loves to smile and giggle. I’ve also learned that she loves for others to be happy. One of her baby friends was sad the other day, and when Ellie saw her baby friend crying, she started crying also! So she really likes everyone around her to be happy and smiling! I love her so much, and I’m so thankful that I am able to capture precious moments like this, so that I can always remember them! Now I’ll never forget the time that Ellie started doing a fishy face all day! 😂 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum
